title: kube-state-metrics restart-loops on rpi01 (liveness livez timeouts)
description: Pod vmks-kube-state-metrics-7c7d886d65-8nw2x (node rpi01): 208 restarts in 4d6h since 2026-10-11T09:12Z; container lives ~38s then /livez times out (159 liveness kills in 4d3h, BackOff x213, exit code 2). Blind-side effect: kube_node_status_condition had no samples 10-11T10:00Z to 10-14T13:00Z, so ALL node alerts were dead for the entire pc01 wedge (tk-lqz, pm:2026-10-14-pc01-qemu-memory-overcommit-wedge). Investigate rpi01 resource starvation (KSM runs BestEffort; liveness period=10s failureThreshold=3 times out), tune KSM resources/scrape config or move it off the offsite Pi. The new KubeNodeMetricsAbsent alert (node-down.yaml) will fire intermittently until this is fixed.
acceptance_criteria: KSM restartCount stops climbing for >= 6h and kube_node_status_condition has continuous samples; KubeNodeMetricsAbsent stays quiet.
